The '''Echani Command''' was the government of the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]], a confederation of six [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] territories known as the [[Six Sisters]]. Headquartered on [[Eshan/Legends|Eshan]], the Command was ruled by an all-[[Gender/Legends|female]] council. The planet [[Begali]] rebelled against Echani Command in [[1154 BBY]], beginning the [[Begali Uprising]], and it was joined by [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]], another of the Six Sisters. Though Begali rejoined the Echani Command less than a century later. Thyrsus continued to fight against the Echani Command for several centuries; it was not until [[899 BBY]] that the [[Pact of Almera]] confirmed the planet's independence.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
